'''Star Tours Flight 1401''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight from [[Spaceport THX1138]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], with passengers including a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]]. Prior to the ship's departure from the spaceport, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents discovered the spy's presence and [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|attempted]] to arrest the Rebel. The vessel took off and fought its way past Imperial ships surrounding the space station. After being chased through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the [[StarSpeeder 1000]] landed and delivered the spy to safety.

The flight was originally intended to be piloted by the [[AC series pilot droid]] [[AC-38/Legends|AC-38]]. However, due to a last-minute mix up, [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was hired by Ace to fix the binary motivator. However, as Ace left the ship and before C-3PO can do the maintenance in the cockpit, he ended up piloting the vessel instead via getting trapped inside by the autopilot which lowers and seals the cockpit shield, thus locking him inside.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
During the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride, this flight's destinations were randomly chosen from several options. These included [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In addition, how it ends up discovered and how it escaped from the station were also randomly chosen from two options. For details about each of the possible segments, see that ride's article.<ref name="ST2" />

Flight number 1401 is a reference to the address of [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Imagineering|Walt Disney Imagineering]]: 1401 Flower St., Glendale, CA 91201.<ref name="9 Facts">{{D23|url=9-out-of-this-world-facts-about-star-tours-30-years-of-continued-adventures|text=9 Out of This World Facts about Star Tours' Over 30 Years of Continued Adventures}}</ref>
